summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made)  I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite schema.  Everything I inspected statically looks **correct**, which is itself important information: - Client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so cookies go out. - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback for watchlist data (confirmed via grep across `client/src`) — the only localStorage usage
